"# Implementation Plan - Franchise Page Magnifying Glass Upgrades (Updated)

Upgrade the magnifying glass functionality on the Franchise Proposal Page ([FranchisePageClient.tsx](file:///d:/anti-gv/25. 120pie(new)_2/app/franchise/FranchisePageClient.tsx)).

## Proposed Bug Fixes

### 1. Fix Blank/White Lens Rendering (Boxes not showing)
*   **Root Cause**: The cloned page content wrapper collapsed to the parent lens size (260px) due to global max-width constraints (e.g. `max-width: 100%` in Next.js/Tailwind resets). Shifting this collapsed container left/top resulted in empty white space inside the lens.
*   **Fix**: Explicitly set the cloned page wrapper's style to:
    *   `width: "100vw"` and `minWidth: "100vw"` to preserve the exact viewport layout.
    *   `maxWidth: "none"` and `maxHeight: "none"` to override global CSS resets.

### 2. Fix Close Button Unclickable (Cursor Physics Trap)
*   **Root Cause**: Because the magnifier lens tracks the cursor coordinates 1:1 instantaneously, the cursor is mathematically locked at the center of the lens. The user can never move the cursor to the close button (top-right of the lens) because the button moves away at the same speed.
*   **Fix**:
    *   Introduce a smooth CSS tracking lag to the outer lens container on mouse movement:
        `transition: left 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), top 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)`
    *   This lag allows the cursor to outrun the center of the lens when moving towards the close button, triggering `onMouseEnter`.
    *   Once hovered, we freeze updates and disable the transition (`transition: "none"`), letting the user click the button.

---

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Cursor Lag Physics**: The magnifier lens will smoothly follow the cursor with a slight lag (120ms). This enables you to hover over the `X` button. Once hovered, the lens locks in place so you can click the `X` to close it.
